C-conf.construction_optimizer: timm create_optimizer_v2 AdamW as in the locally retained upstream-style main.py
C-conf.construction_schedule: official fixed-commit main.py timm cosine; warmup 3, warmup_lr 1e-5, min_lr 1e-5, cooldown 10; reference YAML/main verified by Git blob SHA1
C-conf.claim_scope: one independently constructed long-training start; not isolated causal identification of maturity

F-arch.construction_schedule: research five-epoch warmup and cosine to 1% of peak rate
F-arch.claim_scope: official fixed-commit CIFAR-10 Spikformer-4-384 model ported to 100 classes through documented neuron API compatibility; model/yaml/license Git blob SHA1 verified; full GPU validation pending; not an official CIFAR-100 configuration

selection.native: native_expanded: seven-rate mean native raw validation CE across two screen seeds
selection.dual_strategy: dual_native_common: same native criterion restricted to the common five rates; distinct selected T/rate/seed trajectories are retained and deduplicated by roles
selection.mtt: mtt_joint: mean matched-BN validation CE over e=2,4 then over two screen seeds on the common five rates
selection.checkpoint: maximum validation accuracy; first exact tie

mtt.loss_reduction: sum over configurations; divide only for two microbatches

statistics.unit: paired adaptation seed conditional on each retained start
statistics.multiplicity: Holm separately within C six-test and F three-test families
statistics.cross_cohort: descriptive only; A-expl and A-conf share the same starting checkpoint
statistics.null_rule: failure to reject is not equivalence and does not establish benefit confined to short starts
statistics.J_definition: delta P4_BN minus delta P4_raw, 512 to 2048

equal_time.scope: descriptive measured checkpoints only; no interpolated CE
